[[Nazag Fenn]] is one of two Fenn-family collectors located in Dragon's Gullet in the northern wastes of [[Post-Searing]] [[Ascalon]]. His relative, [[Ashram Fenn]], is found nearby, also in Dragon's Gullet.

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|Dragon's Gullet}}

:''"I'm searching for 9 [[Gruesome Ribcage]]s.  I can offer you one of the following items in exchange. Can you help me?"''
